panels.title: Prediction readiness
panels.description: Composite gate on trusting sell-out predictions: (events · coverage · depth)^⅓. Fills as collection history deepens. <0.33 hide predictions; 0.33–0.80 low-confidence; ≥0.80 reliable.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "campsites")
  |> range(start: -90d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "predict_readiness" and r._field == "readiness")
  |> last()

panels.title: Readiness components
panels.description: The three sub-scores behind the gauge. The lowest one is the current bottleneck (geometric mean, so one near-zero term holds the whole gauge down).

targets.query:
from(bucket: "campsites")
  |> range(start: -90d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "predict_readiness" and (r._field == "event_score" or r._field == "coverage" or r._field == "depth_score"))
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["_field", "_value"])

from(bucket: "campsites")
  |> range(start: -90d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "predict_readiness" and r._field == "band")
  |> last()

panels.title: Events observed
panels.description: Distinct sell-outs seen so far. Target before a stable hazard fit: 500.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "campsites")
  |> range(start: -90d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "predict_readiness" and r._field == "events")
  |> last()

panels.title: Active cells
panels.description: (site, date) cells with ≥2 snapshots, i.e. at least one at-risk interval.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "campsites")
  |> range(start: -90d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "predict_readiness" and r._field == "active_cells")
  |> last()

panels.title: Median depth
panels.description: Median at-risk intervals per active cell. Target burn-down resolution: 6.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "campsites")
  |> range(start: -90d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "predict_readiness" and r._field == "median_depth")
  |> last()

panels.title: Readiness over time
panels.description: The gauge value as history accrues — the curve should climb toward 1.0.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "campsites")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "predict_readiness" and r._field == "readiness")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1d, fn: last, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: Events accumulated
panels.description: Observed sell-outs over time against the 500-event target line.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "campsites")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "predict_readiness" and r._field == "events")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1d, fn: last, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: Expected accuracy boundary
panels.description: Best AUC the sell-out model can reach given history collected so far: 0.5 + 0.34·(1 − e^(−months/3)), rising toward the ~0.84 one-sample-per-annual-peak ceiling. The reference lines are the no-skill floor (0.5) and that ceiling; the curve is the live boundary the model is bounded by until more history accrues. Illustrative model (mirrors PREDICT.md §2), not measured accuracy.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "campsites")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "predict_readiness" and r._field == "expected_accuracy")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1d, fn: last, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: About this dashboard — model, targets & references

options.content:
## How to read this board

**Goal:** predict *when* a specific campsite/date sells out. With little history those predictions are not trustworthy yet — the **readiness gauge** above is the honest gate, and model ETAs stay hidden until it clears.

### The model (robot-geographical-society PREDICT.md)
Sell-out is a **time-to-event / survival** problem on the daily `sites/` snapshots:

- **C0** — build per-(site, date) at-risk intervals from the snapshots.
- **C1** — Kaplan–Meier survival curves per cohort (day-of-week × season × popularity).
- **C2** — discrete-time **logistic hazard** → survival curve → median sell-out ETA + risk band.
- **Expected-accuracy boundary** — best achievable AUC given history so far, 0.5 + 0.34·(1 − e^(−months/3)), rising toward a **~0.84** ceiling (one sample per annual peak).

### Targets — what *ready* means
`readiness = (event_score · coverage · depth_score)^(1/3)` — a geometric mean, so the weakest component holds the gauge down.

| Component | Target | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| events | **500** sell-outs | enough events to fit a stable hazard model |
| coverage | **100%** | cells with ≥2 snapshots (an at-risk interval exists) |
| depth | **6** intervals/cell | burn-down resolution per cell |

Bands: 🔴 **< 0.33** hide · 🟡 **0.33–0.80** low-confidence · 🟢 **≥ 0.80** show ETAs.

### Your data — snapshot 2026-06-04

- **138** campgrounds · **4** collection days (2026-06-01 → 06-04, ≈0.1 month)
- **1,489,812** (site, date) cells · **123,382** active (≥2 snapshots)
- **1,211** sell-outs observed · median depth **1** interval/cell
- **readiness 0.24 🔴 insufficient** — event_score 1.00, coverage 0.08, depth_score 0.17
- expected-accuracy boundary **≈ 0.51**, just above the 0.5 no-skill floor

The bottleneck is **depth & coverage**, not events: most cells have only one snapshot so far, so few at-risk intervals exist. The gauge climbs as the daily collector revisits each site over the coming weeks. *(Snapshot figures — the panels above are live.)*

### References

- Design & checkpoints — **PREDICT.md** · rgs PR [#71](https://github.com/tommyroar/robot-geographical-society/pull/71)
- Readiness + accuracy formulas — [predict/readiness.py](https://github.com/tommyroar/robot-geographical-society/blob/feat/predict-plan/predict/readiness.py), mirrored in `campsites/ingest.py`
- Upstream data — [recreation.gov](https://www.recreation.gov) · [WA goingtocamp](https://washington.goingtocamp.com)
- Methods — [Kaplan–Meier estimator](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kaplan%E2%80%93Meier_estimator) · [survival analysis](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Survival_analysis) · [Brier score](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Brier_score)
